# Widget Documentation for LLMs

> Widget is a UI framework that uses a compiler to let you write concise components that do minimal work in the browser.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://widget.test/llms-medium.txt): A shorter version of the documentation
- [Complete documentation](https://widget.test/llms-full.txt): The complete documentation including all examples

## Individual Package Documentation

- [Widget documentation](https://widget.test/docs/widget/llms.txt): The developer documentation for Widget.
- [WidgetKit documentation](https://widget.test/docs/kit/llms.txt): The developer documentation for WidgetKit.

## Notes

- The abridged documentation excludes legacy compatibility notes
- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
